analisis_evidencia_rubro.description: terse note: what printed items or concept point to a line of business, as distinct from the provider's name alone. If there is no clear printed evidence, say so here — that is what drives categoria_gasto to 'null' below, per rule 4

categoria_gasto.description: inferred from the emitter's line of business, or 'null' when there is no clear indication. This value decides whether the rubro step runs

descripcion.description: a short lowercase phrase of what was bought or what service was rendered, from the printed line items or concept. Never derived from the provider's name

centro_de_costo.description: always 'null' at extraction: filled by a later classification step. Kept in the contract so a consumer reads one shape
